Espécies de uso ritual ou sagrado de pov: Species of ritual or sacred use among Indigenous peoples, and controlled plants, are kept out of the platform, whatever the data source. Including a species of ritual use depends on a protocol agreed with the communities.
Uso ritual e sagrado de povos amazônicos: Ritual and sacred use among Amazonian peoples; out of scope until a CARE protocol is agreed with the communities.
Componente de preparação ritual; mesmo c: Component of a ritual preparation; same criterion as Banisteriopsis caapi.
Secreção de uso ritual indígena (kambô),: Secretion of Indigenous ritual use (kambô), the subject of a dispute over benefit sharing; out of scope until a CARE protocol is in place.
Planta de uso controlado; fora do escopo: Controlled plant; outside the scope of a public-access platform.
Uso ritual indígena; mesmo critério de B: Indigenous ritual use; same criterion as Banisteriopsis caapi.
Espécie tradicionalmente associada a rap: Species traditionally associated with Indigenous ritual snuffs (epena/paricá); out of scope until a CARE protocol is agreed.
Sinônimo/táxon afim usado em preparações: Synonym or related taxon used in Indigenous ritual preparations; same criterion as Virola elongata.
Espécie associada a preparações rituais: Species associated with Indigenous ritual preparations in the northwestern Amazon; out of scope until a CARE protocol is in place.
Um táxon entra no recorte amazônico com: A taxon enters the Amazonian scope with at least {n} GBIF records in the Legal Amazon states ({ufs}). The administrative Legal Amazon includes Maranhão west of 44°W and Cerrado areas in MT, TO and MA; each profile therefore also reports, separately, the records in the ecological Amazon biome and in Maranhão west of 44°W. Amazonian predominance (half or more of the Brazilian records) is stated on both bases: records with a state only, and all records.

A pravastatina é obtida por hidroxilação: Pravastatin is obtained by microbial hydroxylation of mevastatin (compactin, ML-236B), a fungal polyketide that inhibits HMG-CoA reductase.
A atorvastatina, inibidor totalmente sin: Atorvastatin, a fully synthetic HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor, had the fungal metabolite compactin (mevastatin) as its initial lead compound.
A varfarina saiu da série de anticoagula: Warfarin emerged from the series of anticoagulants synthesized from dicoumarol, which forms by microbial oxidation of coumarin in spoiled sweet clover hay.
O lapachol, naftoquinona natural, está n: Lapachol, a natural naphthoquinone, is the origin of atovaquone, a synthetic hydroxynaphthoquinone used against malaria.
A mefloquina, quinolinometanol sintético: Mefloquine, a synthetic quinolinemethanol, is a structural analog of the Cinchona alkaloids quinine and quinidine.
A pentoxifilina, 1-(5-oxo-hexil)-3,7-dim: Pentoxifylline, 1-(5-oxohexyl)-3,7-dimethylxanthine, is a synthetic derivative of theobromine.
O ácido acetilsalicílico (aspirina) é a: Acetylsalicylic acid (aspirin) is the acetylated form of salicylic acid, prepared by Felix Hoffmann at Bayer in 1897.
A cevimelina (SNI-2011, AF102B) foi dese: Cevimeline (SNI-2011, AF102B) was designed as a rigid analog of acetylcholine, an agonist of muscarinic receptors.
O artesunato é derivado hemissuccinato s: Artesunate is a semisynthetic hemisuccinate derivative of artemisinin, an endoperoxide sesquiterpene lactone used against Plasmodium falciparum malaria.
O arteméter é derivado éter metílico sem: Artemether is a semisynthetic methyl ether derivative of artemisinin, an artemisinin-class antimalarial evaluated by WHO in combination therapies.
A amiodarona, antiarrítmico benzofurânic: Amiodarone, a class III benzofuran antiarrhythmic agent, was chemically inspired by khellin, a natural furanochromone from Ammi visnaga.
O cromoglicato dissódico (cromolina), es: Cromolyn sodium (sodium cromoglycate), a first-in-class mast cell stabilizer, emerged from a structural modification program on khellin begun in the 1950s.
A dapagliflozina, inibidor seletivo de S: Dapagliflozin, a selective C-glucoside SGLT2 inhibitor with greater metabolic stability, was designed from the natural glucoside phlorizin.
O oseltamivir, pró-fármaco éster inibido: Oseltamivir, an ester prodrug inhibitor of viral neuraminidase, is synthesized industrially from natural shikimic acid as a chiral starting precursor.
A diidroergotamina é derivado semissinté: Dihydroergotamine is a semisynthetic derivative obtained by selective hydrogenation of a double bond in the ergoline ring system of ergotamine.
A diosmina, glicosídeo flavônico flebotô: Diosmin, a phlebotonic flavone glycoside, is produced commercially by semisynthetic oxidation of hesperidin, an abundant natural flavanone.
Impressões digitais circulares Morgan EC: Morgan ECFP4 circular fingerprints (2048 bits, radius 2, Tanimoto similarity) projected in 2D with deterministic Laplacian spectral initialization (seed 20261111), plus a minimum spanning tree (TMAP).
Proximidade no espaço químico é similari: Proximity in chemical space is 2D topological similarity (Tanimoto, ECFP4) between structures. Pharmacological target and clinical effect are separate records, each with its own source.

Liana amazônica de que foi isolada a (+): Amazonian liana from which (+)-tubocurarine was isolated, the starting point of the neuromuscular blocking agents. The profile gives the isolated structures and the published assays; traditional curare preparations are not described.
Árvore de várzea e igapó (ucuúba-branca): Floodplain tree of várzea and igapó forests (ucuúba-branca), studied for its lignans and neolignans. The profile gathers the metabolites published in scientific journals. Other Virola species, of ritual use, are outside the platform.
Liana amazônica da família Menispermacea: Amazonian liana of the family Menispermaceae, with bisbenzylisoquinoline alkaloids described in the chemical literature. The profile gives the isolated molecules; traditional preparations are not described.
Liana neotropical de que foram isolados: Neotropical liana from which C-toxiferine I and other bisquaternary indole alkaloids were isolated. The profile gives the isolated molecules and the published molecular targets; traditional preparations are not described.
Liana amazônica com alcaloides indólicos: Amazonian liana with indole alkaloids described in the phytochemical literature. The profile gives the isolated molecules; traditional preparations are not described.
